about: What a place publishes and what a capsule at it is handed hold one line per claim key (scope, role and measure), and where the place's own lock holds a line of that key it is the place's own line, ahead of the root's lines the place takes, in the order the fold already gives a place's standing. A root line the place takes stands only where the place holds no line of its key.
